title: Ubiquitination of DDX21 by HERC2 induces a dormancy-like phenotype via the NUCKS1-p21/p27 axis to promote radio-resistance in colorectal cancer cells
task: Elucidate mechanisms of dormancy-like phenotype induction and radioresistance in colorectal cancer cells
key_results: DDX21 downregulation via HERC2-mediated ubiquitination induces G0/G1 arrest; DDX21 suppression increases PD-L1 expression and reduces NUCKS1 transcription, elevating p27/p21 levels
comments: The multi-layered regulatory mechanism (DDX21→NUCKS1→p27/p21 axis) is well-characterized, but the functional relationship between radioresistance and PD-L1-mediated immune evasion warrants further investigation.

model_io.model: CRC spheroid culture with serum deprivation; clinical CRC tissue samples

hypotheses.hypothesis: DDX21 downregulation induces dormancy-like phenotype through p38MAPK activation and AKT suppression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DDX21 knockdown activated p38MAPK and suppressed AKT to inhibit growth

hypotheses.hypothesis: HERC2 mediates DDX21 degradation via K48/K63-linked polyubiquitination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HERC2-dependent ubiquitination of DDX21 helicase core domain drives degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: DDX21 suppresses PD-L1 expression and radio-resistance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DDX21 downregulation increased PD-L1 and radioresistance; DDX21 overexpression reversed both

title: Morphological characteristics of corneal stromal stem cells and their age-related decline
task: Characterize corneal stromal stem cell morphology and age-related functional decline
key_results: SSCs predominantly localize to anterior stroma with epithelial-contacting processes; aging to 2 years reduces SSC numbers and alters morphology, indicating decreased niche regenerative capacity
comments: The study elegantly maps spatial organization of limbal niche cell types but relies on 2D morphological analysis; functional validation of the proposed mesenchymal-epithelial transition mechanism is limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SSCs undergo mesenchymal-epithelial transition-like processes within the limbal niche
hypotheses.result: Subset of SSCs displayed epithelial stem cell-like features, supporting the hypothesis
Confirmed by reduced SSC numbers and morphological alterations at 2 years of age

title: Metastatic promoting role of mesenchymal stem cells in oral squamous cell carcinoma revealed by an improved bone marrow chimeric model
task: Determine MSC contribution to tumor immunity and metastasis using improved bone marrow transplantation model
key_results: MSC-rich tumors exhibited enhanced vascularization and adaptive immune infiltration; lung metastasis occurred only in MSC-rich mice; LepR inhibition unexpectedly increased metastasis
comments: The iBMC method is a significant technical advance for studying MSC physiology, but the context-dependent dual functions of MSCs complicate therapeutic targeting strategies.

model_io.model: Bone marrow chimeric mice with OSCC xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSC abundance determines tumor microenvironment composition and metastatic capacity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MSC-rich tumors developed metastases while MSC-deficient tumors showed necrosis and MDSC infiltration

hypotheses.hypothesis: LepR signaling promotes metastasis through MSC function
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; LepR inhibition unexpectedly increased metastasis, indicating context-dependent functions

title: Skeletal rearrangement in Biginelli reaction for the synthesis of chromenoquinoline fused spirohydantoins and their in silico cytotoxicity study
task: Synthesis and computational evaluation of spirohydantoin compounds for anticancer potential
key_results: Novel skeletal rearrangement of Biginelli reaction produces spirohydantoins fused with chromenoquinoline; in silico docking shows strong binding to kinesin Eg5 and 17 other tumor-associated targets
comments: In silico predictions alone; no experimental cytotoxicity validation provided despite the abstract title.

model_io.model: Molecular docking simulation against protein targets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spirohydantoins fused with chromenoquinoline scaffolds exhibit strong binding to cancer-relevant kinase targets
hypotheses.result: Strong binding efficiency demonstrated by molecular docking against kinesin Eg5 and related tumor targets

title: A multi-modal deep learning framework for enhanced breast cancer diagnosis using mammograms and clinical data
task: Breast cancer diagnosis from mammograms and clinical data
key_results: Classification accuracy 94.6% (95% CI: 92.8–96.4%), AUC 0.963 (95% CI: 0.951–0.975), outperforming baselines (p < 0.01)
comments: Clinical data are synthetic with known distributions rather than real paired data, limiting clinical applicability.

model_io.model: Multi-modal deep learning with hierarchical fusion, cross-model attention, dynamic modality weighting, and ROI care module

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating mammograms with clinical data via hierarchical fusion and attention mechanisms improves diagnostic accuracy over unimodal baselines
hypotheses.result: Achieved 94.6% accuracy and 0.963 AUC, statistically significant improvement (p < 0.01)

title: Structure-aware 3D diffusion generation for kidney MRI via mask-guided noise scheduling and topology-prior constraints
task: Generate high-quality 3D kidney MRI images using structure-aware diffusion models
key_results: FID improved from 18.74 to 11.16; KID from 7.983 to 4.573; PSNR from 26.214 to 28.577; LPIPS from 13.442 to 5.7543; synthetic data improves downstream segmentation cross-domain robustness
comments: Combination of organ-mask guidance and topology priors provides complementary structural constraints; synthetic data demonstrates practical utility for domain adaptation.

model_io.model: Structure-aware 3D diffusion generation framework with organ-mask-guided adaptive noise scheduling and topology-prior conditional injection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Organ-mask-guided noise scheduling preserves critical kidney structures during diffusion
hypotheses.result: Improved FID, KID, PSNR, LPIPS metrics; ablation confirms independent and combined benefit

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic data pre-training improves segmentation cross-domain robustness from generated to real kidney MRI
hypotheses.result: Transfer learning on synthetic data effectively improved downstream real-data segmentation

title: An effective two-stage key frame extraction method for speech-visual emotion recognition
task: Extract speech-visual key frames for emotion recognition with reduced redundancy
key_results: Two-stage method using information entropy for VKF extraction and silent-segment removal for SKF extraction; improved inference and generalization across RML, eNTERFACE05, MEAD, BAUM-1s datasets
comments: Method provides interpretable weighted fusion but specific quantitative metrics are not reported in the abstract.

model_io.model: Two-stage key frame extraction using information entropy and aligned speech-visual fusion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Information entropy-based VKF extraction reduces visual redundancy while preserving emotional information
hypotheses.result: Improved inference and generalization performance on four emotion recognition datasets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aligned second-stage SVKFs better capture emotion-critical information than naive concatenation
hypotheses.result: Better generalization demonstrated across multiple datasets

title: Reliability and readability of five AI chatbots for concussion health advice across retrieval augmented and pretrained models
task: Evaluate AI chatbots for concussion health advice accuracy and readability
key_results: Perplexity Pro achieved highest DISCERN (47.36 ± 4.84) and EQIP (65.00 ± 5.48) scores (p < 0.01); RAG models outperformed LLMs; all models exceeded 6th-grade reading level (most >10th-grade); transparency uniformly low across all
comments: RAG architectures improve clinical accuracy but remain insufficient for safe clinical integration without human verification.

model_io.model: Five AI platforms: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and pre-trained LLMs
inputs: 11 high-volume Google Trends patient concussion queries
outputs: text responses scored on DISCERN, EQIP, GQS, JAMA benchmarks, and readability indices (FRES, FKGL, GFI, CLI, ARI, SMOG)

hypotheses.hypothesis: RAG-based architectures provide more clinically reliable concussion advice than standard pre-trained LLMs
hypotheses.result: Perplexity Pro (RAG) outperformed ChatGPT and Gemini on DISCERN/EQIP (p < 0.01) but transparency remained uniformly poor

title: Physics-informed Koopman learning approach for fixed-time synchronization of stochastic neural dynamics
task: Fixed-time synchronization of stochastic Hindmarsh-Rose neurons under mixed noise
key_results: Non-singular controller achieves convergence within pre-determined settling time independent of initial conditions; event-triggering mechanism reduces communication bandwidth while maintaining synchronization
comments: Physics-informed lifting dictionary design is a principled alternative to generic basis functions, though the approach is validated only numerically without experimental implementation.

model_io.model: Hindmarsh-Rose neuron dynamics with Koopman lifting

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-informed lifting dictionary derived from HR algebraic structure improves controller design over generic basis functions
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated theoretically; numerical validation provided but comparative performance metrics not quantified

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-singular FXT controller converges within predetermined time regardless of initial conditions
hypotheses.result: Convergence achieved in numerical simulations with fixed settling time
